pages.lesson:
LESSON: GIFTS OF NATURE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: General
Strand: Creation 1. 1 Creation in Buddh and Sikh faiths (8 lessons) • Scriptural stories
Topic 1.2: Gifts of Nature
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Gifts of Nature, part of Creation 1. 1 Creation in Buddh and Sikh faiths (8 lessons) • Scriptural stories in Grade 6 General.

Key inquiry question: How do specific birds and animals give symbolic significance in different faiths? 2. How do Scriptural stories show interdependence of nature and humans?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. give names of selected birds and animals from the four faiths,

2. discuss with peers the religious importance of selected animals and birds,

3. prepare a skit from a Scriptural story and perform it as a group activity,

4. draw animals and birds of religious importance using digital devices,

5. take videos and photos of birds and animals and identify the ones of religious importance,

6. listen to radio lessons and stories related to birds and animals of religious importance/watch videos,

7. participate in a charity walk to raise funds to preserve the environment,

8. visit the temple/museum to observe pictures/murals/sculptures of birds and animals,

9. assist learners with special needs as per their abilities through peer teaching importance of birds and animals that are considered sacred, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. give names of selected birds and animals from the four faiths,
2. discuss with peers the religious importance of selected animals and birds,
3. prepare a skit from a Scriptural story and perform it as a group activity,
4. draw animals and birds of religious importance using digital devices,
5. take videos and photos of birds and animals and identify the ones of religious importance,
6. listen to radio lessons and stories related to birds and animals of religious importance/watch videos,
7. participate in a charity walk to raise funds to preserve the environment,
8. visit the temple/museum to observe pictures/murals/sculptures of birds and animals,
9. assist learners with special needs as per their abilities through peer teaching importance of birds and animals that are considered sacred, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Gifts of Nature together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: Learner becomes self-disciplined when discussing with peers to highlight symbolic significance of birds

and animals of religious importance as related to Enlightened Beings.

● Digital Literacy: Learner interacts with technology while taking videos and photos of birds and animals and identifying the

ones of religious importance.

Values:
Love: Learner develops virtue of peace when visiting the temple/museum to observe pictures/murals/sculptures of birds and

animals.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship: Learner enhances social cohesions when participating in charity walks to raise funds to preserve the environment.

Links to other Learning Areas:
• Learner is able to relate to the skills of classifying and giving names of birds and animals in their four faiths to the skills of

giving names to birds and animals learnt in Agriculture & Nutrition.

• Learner is able to relate to the skills of using digital devices and drawing animals and birds of religious importance to the

skills of drawing learnt in Creative Arts.
